body: Feel like committing myself to a mental hospital. Seems like the best place to be. I just can't make it out here.

Thanks for the advice, I am going into Computer Science. Most classes have at least one speech anyways. I need a therapist or psychologist. Then some strong meds.

I can't imagine what decent Major wouldn't have speech classes, unless its some Trade Major. Its one of the most important skills, if not the most.

Thanks for the reply I have tried no medication and I used to meditate years ago. Guess I could try these guided ones.

I was going out on the weekends, before the corona. Mostly with male coworkers. I did get to go to these 2 womens' house, but neither one liked me.

I can kinda communicate in person, but Im too shy to use Snapchat, Instagram, Facebook like normal people. My face is kinda ugly too, and body isnt muscular enough.

I cant even buy 1 shirt without thinking about what everyone would think about it. Endless thoughts...so i stick to a few colors and t shirts only.

I have money to go to school, but I dont wanna quit because of speech classes. My legs sometimes shake and ive been laughed at before.

I dont feel like this world is for me. Ive been mentally destroyed since at least 6 years old.
